Dear Daniel, 

 

We’re thrilled to announce the launch of Course 4 in our Data Analytics Professional Certificate: Data I/O and Preprocessing with Python and SQL is now available for enrollment!​

Enroll Here

In this course, you’ll jump in to the data processing lifecycle, and learn to work with the kind of datasets that professionals encounter every day. 

 

Whether it's scraped from websites, retrieved through APIs, or stored in databases, this data is often incomplete, messy, and assembled from multiple sources. You’ll learn to systematically collect and clean this data using Python and SQL, and turn raw inputs into structured, reliable datasets ready for analysis.

 

Join this course to get hands on experience:

  • Extracting data from websites using Python libraries like Beautiful Soup while adhering to ethical guidelines.
  • Accessing real-time data through APIs, parsing JSON, and managing authentication with API keys.
  • Cleaning and preprocessing text and numerical data, handling missing values, normalization, and more.
  • Connecting to databases, writing SQL queries, and performing joins to combine data from multiple tables.

According to an analysis of 1,000 U.S. data analyst job postings, SQL is mentioned in 60% of listings, while Python appears in 78%.

 

Learning both tools positions you to take on the next step of analytics work with an in-demand skillset.

Enroll Now

Keep learning,

The DeepLearning.AI team
